articles.title: Midnight Sprints and 200 Species: Inside the Teen Birding World Series
articles.summary: At midnight in a deserted New Jersey park, three teens vaulted a fence and spotted a monk parakeet—their first of a 24-hour race to count 200 bird species. The Pete Dunnelins have won twice before and planned every minute of their route.

articles.title: Iran War Drives Gas to $4.50, Inflation Hits 3-Year High
articles.summary: U.S. inflation surged to 3.8% in April as gasoline prices jumped 44% from last year. The war with Iran has blocked the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial oil passage. Families are cutting back as wage gains are erased.

articles.title: eBay Rejects GameStop's $56B Bid as 'Neither Credible Nor Attractive'
articles.summary: eBay dismissed GameStop's $56 billion takeover offer, citing financing doubts and its own strong performance. GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen, who holds a 5% stake, may take the bid directly to shareholders. eBay's stock has returned 201% under its current CEO.
